body_html:
A clean, contemporary anchor for reception areas and lounge settings where space is at a premium. The Global Citi 7889 square coffee table pairs a tempered glass top with slim metal legs, giving waiting rooms, offices, and clinics a polished focal point that stays out of the way. Its compact 33" x 33" footprint and low 15" profile sit comfortably alongside lounge seating and sofas.

Features

  • Square 33" x 33" footprint suited to compact reception and lounge areas
  • Low 15" height that pairs naturally with lounge chairs and sofas
  • Tempered glass top for a clean, contemporary look
  • 2" diameter metal legs available in chrome or powder-coat finish
  • Black non-marring glides to protect flooring
  • Part of the Citi series — coordinate with matching end tables, sofas, and lounge chairs

Specifications

Overall dimensions 33"W x 33"D x 15"H. Tempered glass top with metal legs; laminate tops are also available across the Citi series. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty, with five years on electrical components and textiles.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Citi 7889 coffee table or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec a full reception or lounge area.
